lyon-pilat-ridge-and-rh-ne-balcony.title: Lyon · Pilat Ridge and Rhône Balcony
lyon-pilat-ridge-and-rh-ne-balcony.slogan: A close mountain escape with ridge views and fast weather changes.
lyon-pilat-ridge-and-rh-ne-balcony.story: A close mountain escape with ridge views and fast weather changes. 138 km round from Vienne - plan on about 2 h 39 of riding. It goes by way of Pilat forest bends and Condrieu  by river. The climb of the day is Col de l’Oeillon ridge. The passes are the reason to go.
